audit.whatIsWrong: diff HARD at 8/10 and report[14] quoting 45.35%, against a packet win rate of 52.82% over 142 games. The packet also flags the chart as contradicting the data (Neeko 5 stages to 1).
audit.why: A lane Yi wins more than half the time cannot be rated 8/10 hard, and the page currently shows a win rate that does not exist in the data.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 5/10, tone recoloured, and the two prose statements restated at 52.82%. The lane is still lost early and won late — that is what 5/10 encodes here.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 5 (First item) gives Neeko the stage in both layers, but the packet chart says Skill and whys[5] already reads 'evening it out'.
audit.why: The first-item stage is exactly where Yi's on-hit arrives; calling it Neeko's contradicts the same page's own why-text and the packet.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and win[5] both flipped to Skill as a matched pair, with the rating and why adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the content layer said Neeko's CC cancels Meditate, that Highlander's immunity covers slows only (not her root or stun), or that Pop Blossom's wind-up is hidden while she is disguised.
audit.why: These three decide when Yi may channel, when he may commit, and why the ult sometimes arrives with no visible tell.
audit.corrected: early names the Meditate cancel with Q's 9s and E's 12s; whys[6] and mid state the slow-only immunity and the hidden wind-up; spikes[1] carries Pop Blossom's 120s.
sources: ownerKit R 'immune to all slowing effects'
enemyKit R 'The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised'

edits.before: Kraken/BORK spike your on-hit DPS so you can finally burst her squishy body — but only if you dodge R with Alpha Strike's untargetable frames; eat the stun and you still die first.
edits.after: Kraken/BORK spike your on-hit DPS so you can burst her squishy body — it comes down to dodging her E root with Alpha Strike's untargetable frames; eat it and you still die first.

edits.before: Highlander and true damage let you dive and out-scale her squishy burst kit late.
edits.after: Highlander blanks only slows, so her root still lands — true damage kills her.

edits.before: Neeko controls the early game with range: Blooming Burst waves and Tangle-Barbs roots poke a melee Yi down with no counterplay, and her passive empowers a burst you can't trade into, so play safe and farm.
edits.after: Neeko controls the early with range: Blooming Burst is up every 9s and Tangle-Barbs roots on 12s, and either one cancels Meditate mid-channel — only heal once her E is spent, and take the poke rather than the root.

edits.before: Through level 5 she keeps kill pressure — a Tangle-Barbs root or a level-6 Pop Blossom into her combo can still one-shot you — so this window is hers until you can reliably dodge with Alpha Strike.
edits.after: She holds kill pressure through 6 — Pop Blossom is 120s at rank 1 and its wind-up is hidden while she wears a disguise, so a root into it still one-shots you; the window is hers until you dodge with Alpha Strike.

edits.before: Pop Blossom is a delayed AoE stun-burst ult — if you all-in without watching for it, the root into full combo one-shots you, so respect her level-6 kill pressure.
edits.after: Pop Blossom is a delayed AoE stun-burst on 120s at rank 1, and its wind-up is hidden while she is disguised — if a Tangle-Barbs root lands first, the full combo one-shots you.

edits.before: It's 8/10 because she has point-and-click CC (E root) and AOE lockdown (R stun) that ignore your only defensive tool — Alpha Strike's untargetability ends the instant the blink does, and Highlander's slow immunity doesn't stop a stun or root. She out-ranges, out-trades, and out-picks you for the entire window before your items, which is exactly when junglers collapse on the weak early Yi.
edits.after: It's 5/10 and you take it 52.82%: her E root and R stun ignore your only defensive tool — Alpha Strike's untargetability ends the instant the blink does, and Highlander's immunity covers slows, not a stun or root. She out-ranges and out-picks you for the whole pre-item window, which is when junglers collapse on the weak early Yi — then it inverts completely.

edits.before: Neeko owns levels 1 through 6 (poke, root, then R lockdown); favor only crosses to you at first on-hit item and tilts decisively yours at 2+ items.
edits.after: Neeko owns levels 1 through 6 (poke, root, then R lockdown); it levels out at your first on-hit item and tilts decisively yours at 2+ items.

edits.before: HARD (45.35% WR): Neeko's point-and-click root and AOE stun beat your only escape and out-pick you for the entire pre-item window — survive even, save Q for her R, itemize QSS/MR, and your scaling does the rest.
edits.after: EVEN (52.82% WR): Neeko's root and AOE stun beat your only escape and out-pick you for the entire pre-item window — survive even, save Q for her E, itemize MR, and your scaling does the rest.

notes: Row 5 was the only chart disagreement with the packet and it is proposed as a matched full/content pair. I left the QSS/Mercurial advice in report[8] and dosFull[2] alone rather than strengthening it — cleanse eligibility against Pop Blossom is not in the kit data and I could not verify it; see unverified.
